program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (symmetric-crop? obj)
      (let ((crop (subgrid g (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj))))
        (all? (lambda (r)
                (all? (lambda (c) (= (at crop r c) (at crop r (- (cols crop) 1 c))))
                      (range 0 (cols crop))))
              (range 0 (rows crop)))))
    (let ((chosen (first (sort (filter symmetric-crop? (objects g 0))
                               (lambda (a b)
                                 (if (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))
                                     (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))
                                     (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))))))))
      (subgrid g (obj-r1 chosen) (obj-c1 chosen) (obj-r2 chosen) (obj-c2 chosen)))))
